SEAT RE | status: NEED-MORE
did: T22 - wrote ops/RE-PS3-MAP.md. 7 PS3 rows resolved, 5 explicitly unconfirmed. One blocking caveat and one finding that affects the plan of record.
evidence:
(0) CAVEAT: ps3_pubnames.txt and ops/evidence/ps3_p1_map.tsv addresses do NOT resolve in scimitar_final.elf. 0x001a7cf3 decodes to nothing, 0x001b7c91 to garbage. The scimitar_final.map Address column does. Control: AbstractEntityAI::GetComponentContainer @ .map 0x0039877c size 0xc = addi r3,r3,0x90 / clrldi / blr - a 12-byte 'return this+0x90'. Use the .map.
(1) HIGH: Faction::Faction() PS3 0x01d1af14 (0x60) <-> PC 0x0019123B0. Both ctors init two inline containers at +0xC and +0x14 (PS3 addi r3,r3,0xc / addi r29,r29,0x14; PC sub_A062A0(a1+12) / sub_A062A0(a1+20)).
(2) HIGH: Entity::GetComponentByType(ClassDescriptor const*) PS3 0x006a3e68 (0x54) <-> PC 0x005200C0 (51 B). Same thin wrapper: base@+0x60, count*4, compare, return 0.
(3) MED-HIGH: EntityBuilder::BuildEntityWithSelector PS3 0x006aa328 (0xd8) <-> PC 0x005FAC00 (94 B). PC fills Entity*& via vtbl+76 then vtbl+64 with RowSelector&.
(4) HIGH: Entity::SetGlobalMatrixInternal PS3 0x006a5248 (0x200) <-> PC 0x00528200. PS3 copies Matrix44 with lvx/stvx +0x10 strides; PC address already independently known from SgmDetour.
(5) UNCONFIRMED PC: PlayerPerceptionMonitor::OnEnter (PS3 0x016044cc, 0x30), IsEnemyOfThePlayer::OnEnter (0x0167b224, 0xb0; reads +0xC->+0x60->+0x5C->+0xAD0; only two PC functions touch +0xAD0, 0x16CE1C0 and 0x19AD670, neither matches), Faction::IsIn (0x01d28f44), and BOTH faction-chain steps PC sub_6F5F70 and sub_133A4C0 have no PS3 name yet.
FINDING: PS3 GetComponentByType reads the component COUNT at +0x64 (two independent functions: 0x6a3e68 and 0x6a2bd0), while PC 0x5200C0 reads it at +0x66. C1 needs a re-check - do NOT flip +0x66 on this alone; settle with a live dump of one entity +0x60..+0x68.
next: name the faction chain by scanning .map functions <=0x40 whose body is lwz rX,0xE8(rY) then lwz rX,0x1C; then vtable-shape match for the two statechart nodes.
